observed_evidence: Three years ago only a few people in maintenance mode; Jun-2026 team >60
decision_read: Live-service revival required a much larger multidisciplinary team than maintenance mode
ops_cat_translation: Do not infer Ops Cat needs 60; separate MVP and mature LiveOps staffing

observed_evidence: Supercell rebuilt the team after deciding maintenance mode underinvested the title
decision_read: Installed-base value can justify reinvestment years after launch
ops_cat_translation: Stage capital and staffing by evidence

observed_evidence: New team member identified onboarding as slow/clunky; team rebuilt it
decision_read: FTUE is not frozen after launch
ops_cat_translation: Instrument FTUE from day one and preserve redesign ability

observed_evidence: Boat/Truck experiments and Tiny Trail/Fresh Beats were limited to some players before wider release
decision_read: Core and event changes are experiments not one-shot launches
ops_cat_translation: Build feature flags/cohort control into Ops Cat foundation

observed_evidence: Article names Release Manager LiveOps Manager Analytics Lead and QA
decision_read: Mature operations explicitly require release LiveOps analytics and QA disciplines
ops_cat_translation: Cover these responsibilities even if small-team roles are combined

observed_evidence: Team reads Reddit and TikTok; some player ideas enter the game
decision_read: Community is part of product discovery not only support

observed_evidence: Wedding decor Oktoberfest Indian festival events Finnish blueberries cited as team-inspired
decision_read: Authentic cultural context can improve seasonal content
ops_cat_translation: Use a repeatable cultural review process for US-first/global-secondary

observed_evidence: Joe Jonas event spans in-game soundtrack milestones web remix TikTok and permanent decoration
decision_read: High-end LiveOps burden can extend beyond game client
ops_cat_translation: Defer until reusable in-game engine and CRM are proven
